#PDP
```{r PDP}
library(DALEX)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidysdm)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)


# Function to create and return combined PDP plots
plot_combined_pdp <- function(var, label) {
  apicalis_pdp <- model_profile(apicalis_explainer, N = 500, variables = var)
  conditor_pdp <- model_profile(conditor_explainer, N = 500, variables = var)

  apicalis_data <- apicalis_pdp$agr_profiles %>% mutate(Species = "Leporillus apicalis")
  conditor_data <- conditor_pdp$agr_profiles %>% mutate(Species = "Leporillus conditor")

  combined <- bind_rows(apicalis_data, conditor_data)

  p <- ggplot(combined, aes(x = `_x_`, y = `_yhat_`, colour = Species)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Leporillus apicalis" = "#BC43FF", "Leporillus conditor" = "#00D19B")) +
    labs(
      x = label,
      y = "Predicted Suitability",
      colour = "Species"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "vertical",   # <- make legend vertical
      legend.box = "vertical",          # <- stack legend items vertically
      legend.margin = margin(t = 0),   # <- add space above legend
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(combined_outdir, paste0("pdp_", var, "_comparison.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}

# Generate plots
pdp_bio05 <- plot_combined_pdp("bio05", "Maximum temperature of warmest month (°C)")
pdp_bio06 <- plot_combined_pdp("bio06", "Minimum temperature of coldest month (°C)")
pdp_bio12 <- plot_combined_pdp("bio12", "Annual precipitation (mm)")
```

# Create zoomed BIO12 PDP
```{r}


# Create zoomed BIO12 PDP (125–700 mm)

plot_zoomed_bio12 <- function() {
  # Generate PDPs
  apicalis_pdp <- model_profile(apicalis_explainer, N = 500, variables = "bio12")
  conditor_pdp <- model_profile(conditor_explainer, N = 500, variables = "bio12")
  
  # Add species labels
  apicalis_data <- apicalis_pdp$agr_profiles %>% mutate(Species = "Leporillus apicalis")
  conditor_data <- conditor_pdp$agr_profiles %>% mutate(Species = "Leporillus conditor")
  
  # Combine data
  combined <- bind_rows(apicalis_data, conditor_data)
  
  # Create plot with x-axis limits
  p <- ggplot(combined, aes(x = `_x_`, y = `_yhat_`, colour = Species)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Leporillus apicalis" = "#BC43FF", "Leporillus conditor" = "#00D19B")) +
    labs(
      x = "Annual precipitation (mm; detail view)",
      y = "Predicted Suitability",
      colour = "Species"
    ) +
   scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = seq(125, 400, by = 50),
  minor_breaks = seq(125, 400, by = 25)
) +
coord_cartesian(xlim = c(125, 400)) +  # Zoom to 125–700 mm
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.margin = margin(t = 10),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  # Save plot with updated filename
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(combined_outdir, "pdp_bio12_zoomed_125_400mm.png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}

# Call the function to create and save the zoomed plot
plot_zoomed_bio12()

pdp_bio12_zoomed <- plot_zoomed_bio12()
```

```{r}

library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)  # alpha()
library(grid)    # unit()

# ---- helper: place tag inside the panel using panel ranges ----
tag_inside <- function(p, tag, x_frac = 0.97, y_frac = 0.94) {
  b <- ggplot_build(p)
  pp <- b$layout$panel_params[[1]]
  xr <- pp$x.range
  yr <- pp$y.range

  x <- xr[1] + x_frac * diff(xr)
  y <- yr[1] + y_frac * diff(yr)

  p + annotate(
    "text",
    x = x, y = y, label = tag,
    hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
    fontface = "bold", size = 4
  )
}


# ---- (a) bio05: no legend, tag inside ----

p_a <- tag_inside(p_a, "(a)")

p_b <- tag_inside(p_b, "(b)")



# ---- (c) bio12: legend inside top-right, tag inside ----

# ---- (d) bio12 zoomed: cropped version of (c), remove y-axis title, no legend, tag inside ----

  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8)
  ) +

p_d <- tag_inside(p_d, "(d)")



# ---- combine 2x2 (only panel (c) shows legend) ----

combined_pdp_all <- (p_a + p_b) / (p_c + p_d) +
```

#Variable importance
```{r}
# ---- Combined variable importance (apicalis + conditor) ----
# Preconditions: apicalis_ensemble, conditor_ensemble exist
# Outputs: one CSV + one plot in combined_outdir

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DALEX)
  library(tidysdm)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
})



# ---- Build explainers ----
apicalis_explainer <- explain_tidysdm(apicalis_ensemble)
conditor_explainer <- explain_tidysdm(conditor_ensemble)

# ---- Helper: permutation importance -> one row per variable ----
get_vip <- function(explainer, species_label) {

  DALEX::model_parts(explainer = explainer) |>
    dplyr::filter(!variable %in% c("_baseline_", "_full_model_")) |>
    dplyr::group_by(variable) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      `Mean drop-out loss` = mean(dropout_loss, na.rm = TRUE),
      `SD`                = sd(dropout_loss,   na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Species = species_label
    ) |>
    dplyr::rename(`Environmental variable` = variable)
}

vip_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  get_vip(apicalis_explainer, "Leporillus apicalis"),
  get_vip(conditor_explainer, "Leporillus conditor")
)

# ---- Wide table (easy to compare side-by-side) ----
vip_wide <- vip_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("Leporillus apicalis", "Leporillus conditor"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(`Environmental variable`, Species) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Species,
    values_from = c(`Mean drop-out loss`, SD)
  )

# Round only at the end (keeps numeric types during reshaping)
vip_wide <- vip_wide |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Mean drop-out loss_Leporillus apicalis`  = round(`Mean drop-out loss_Leporillus apicalis`, 3),
    `SD_Leporillus apicalis`                  = round(`SD_Leporillus apicalis`, 3),
    `Mean drop-out loss_Leporillus conditor`  = round(`Mean drop-out loss_Leporillus conditor`, 3),
    `SD_Leporillus conditor`                  = round(`SD_Leporillus conditor`, 3)
  )

print(vip_wide)

write.csv(
  vip_wide,
  file.path(vip_outdir, "combined_variable_importance_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ---- Plot: mean drop-out loss by variable, two species (same y-axis) ----
vip_plot_data <- vip_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("Leporillus apicalis", "Leporillus conditor")),
    `Environmental variable` = factor(`Environmental variable`)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(`Environmental variable`) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # order variables by average importance across species
    avg_importance = mean(`Mean drop-out loss`, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Environmental variable` = forcats::fct_reorder(`Environmental variable`, avg_importance, .desc = TRUE)
  )

# ---- One-panel combined variable importance (matched aesthetics) ----

vip_plot_data <- vip_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("Leporillus apicalis", "Leporillus conditor")),
    `Environmental variable` = factor(`Environmental variable`, levels = c("bio05", "bio06", "bio12"))
  )

vip_plot <- ggplot(
  vip_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = `Environmental variable`,
    y = `Mean drop-out loss`,
    fill = Species
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = `Mean drop-out loss` - SD,
      ymax = `Mean drop-out loss` + SD
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Leporillus apicalis" = "#BC43FF",
      "Leporillus conditor" = "#00D19B"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Environmental variable",
    y = "Drop-out loss"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),

    axis.text        = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 12),

    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key       = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(vip_outdir, "combined_variable_importance_onepanel.png"),
  plot = vip_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

vip_plot
```

```{r}
# ---- One-panel combined VIP (match the example style) ----
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)   # alpha()
})

# vip_all must already exist with:
# Environmental variable, Mean drop-out loss, SD, Species

# ---- One-panel combined VIP (legend top-right, labels above bars) ----

vip_plot_data <- vip_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species = factor(
      Species,
      levels = c("Leporillus apicalis", "Leporillus conditor")
    ),
    `Environmental variable` = factor(
      `Environmental variable`,
      levels = c("bio12", "bio06", "bio05")
    )
  )

dodge_w <- 0.72

vip_plot <- ggplot(
  vip_plot_data,
  aes(
    y = `Environmental variable`,
    x = `Mean drop-out loss`,
    fill = Species
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    width = 0.62
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = `Mean drop-out loss` - SD,
      xmax = `Mean drop-out loss` + SD
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    height = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  # ---- variable labels just above the bars ----
geom_text(
  data = vip_plot_data |>
    dplyr::distinct(`Environmental variable`),
  aes(
    y = as.numeric(`Environmental variable`) + 0.38,  # vertical offset ABOVE bars
    x = 0.005,                                         # near y-axis, not bar end
    label = `Environmental variable`
  ),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  hjust = 0,
  vjust = 0,
  size = 3.6
  ) +

scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "Leporillus apicalis" = "#BC43FF",
    "Leporillus conditor" = "#00D19B"
  ),
  labels = c(
    expression(italic("Leporillus apicalis")),
    expression(italic("Leporillus conditor"))
  )

  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(labels = NULL) +

  labs(
    x = "Drop-out loss",
    y = "Environmental variable",
    fill = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),

    axis.ticks.y     = element_blank(),

    # ---- legend top-right inside panel ----
    legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),
    legend.justification = c(1, 1),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.85),
      colour = NA
    ),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.9, "lines"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(0.9, "lines")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(vip_outdir, "combined_variable_importance_onepanel_matchedstyle.png"),
  plot = vip_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 300,

)
```

```{r centroid combined}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)

# Define shared colour scale
viridis_colours <- viridis(41, option = "H")

# Panel (a) — apicalis
p1 <- ggplot(apicalis_centroids, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude)) +
  geom_path(colour = "grey50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = time_bp), size = 2) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = viridis_colours,
    name = "Years BP",
    limits = c(-40000, 0),
    breaks = c(-40000, -30000, -20000, -10000, 0),
    labels = c("40k", "30k", "20k", "10k", "0")
  ) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(129, 131), ylim = c(-28, -24.8)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Latitude") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),

    # Legend inside panel (a), bottom-left with padding
    legend.position = c(0.08, 0.08),
    legend.justification = c(0, 0),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.85),
      colour = NA
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  # Panel label (a)
annotate(
  "text",
  x = 130.95, y = -27.90,
  label = expression(italic("L. apicalis")),
  hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
  size = 5
)


# Panel (b) — conditor
p2 <- ggplot(conditor_centroids, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude)) +
  geom_path(colour = "grey50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = time_bp), size = 2) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = viridis_colours,
    limits = c(-40000, 0),
    breaks = c(-40000, -30000, -20000, -10000, 0),
    labels = c("40k", "30k", "20k", "10k", "0"),
    guide = "none"   # legend only in panel (a)
  ) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(129, 131), ylim = c(-28, -24.8)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),

    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  # Panel label (b)
annotate(
  "text",
  x = 130.95, y = -27.9,
  label = expression(italic("L. conditor")),
  hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
  size = 5
)



# Combine plots side-by-side
final_plot <- p1 + p2 +
  plot_layout(guides = "keep") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Centroid shift of predicted habitat through time",
    caption = "Longitude",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
  )

# Save output
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(combined_outdir, "combined_centroid_shift_plot.png"),
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r histograms-1deg-two-species, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# ---- Preconditions ----
stopifnot(
  inherits(middens_sf, "sf"),
  inherits(apicalis_spatrast_coarse, "SpatRaster"),
  inherits(conditor_spatrast_coarse, "SpatRaster"),
  dir.exists(results_dir)
)

# ---- Settings ----
thr_a   <- if (exists("opt_threshold")) opt_threshold else 0.27
dpi_out <- 300
x_max   <- 0.9
# ---- Histogram theme (ggplot-native, overrides defaults) ----
theme_hist_clean <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3)
  )

# ---- Helpers (same logic as your script) ----
ensure_time_cols <- function(m_sf, rt) {
  m_sf %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      binned_time_bp = sapply(time_bp, function(x) rt[which.min(abs(rt - x))]),
      nearest_idx    = match(binned_time_bp, rt)
    )
}

fd_bin_count <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(30L)
  fd_bw <- 2 * IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE) / (length(x)^(1/3))
  max(20, min(60, round(1 / max(min(fd_bw, 0.08), 0.02))))
}

time_matched_background <- function(m_sf, rast) {
  rt <- as.numeric(terra::time(rast))
  m_sf <- ensure_time_cols(m_sf, rt)

  split(m_sf, m_sf$binned_time_bp) |>
    lapply(function(df_i) {
      tb  <- unique(df_i$binned_time_bp)[1]
      lyr <- match(tb, rt)
      if (is.na(lyr)) return(NULL)

      vals <- terra::spatSample(
        rast[[lyr]],
        size   = nrow(df_i),
        method = "random",
        values = TRUE,
        na.rm  = TRUE
      )[, 1] |> as.numeric()

      tibble::tibble(
        suitability = vals,
        group       = "Background (time-matched)",
        bin         = tb
      )
    }) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows()
}

# Extract midden suitability from the *same* raster you are plotting
extract_mid_suitability <- function(m_sf, rast) {
  rt <- as.numeric(terra::time(rast))
  m_sf_c <- ensure_time_cols(m_sf, rt)

  mid_vals <- terra::extract(rast, terra::vect(m_sf_c), ID = FALSE) |> as.matrix()
  mid_suit <- mid_vals[cbind(seq_len(nrow(mid_vals)), m_sf_c$nearest_idx)] |> as.numeric()

  list(m_sf = m_sf_c, mid_suit = mid_suit)
}

make_coarse_hist <- function(rast, m_sf, thr_a, x_max, drop_x_axis = FALSE, legend_inside = FALSE) {

  ex <- extract_mid_suitability(m_sf, rast)
  m_sf_c   <- ex$m_sf
  mid_suit <- ex$mid_suit

  mid_df <- tibble::tibble(
    suitability = mid_suit,
    group       = "Middens",
    bin         = m_sf_c$binned_time_bp
  )

  bg_df <- time_matched_background(m_sf_c, rast)

  plot_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(mid_df, bg_df) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(suitability))

  bins_a <- fd_bin_count(mid_df$suitability)

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = suitability, fill = group)) +
    geom_histogram(
      position = "identity", alpha = 0.65,
      bins = bins_a, boundary = 0, colour = "white"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = thr_a, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Middens" = "#BC43FF",
      "Background (time-matched)" = "#9AA0A6"
    )) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, x_max), breaks = seq(0, x_max, 0.1)) +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      x = if (drop_x_axis) NULL else "Modelled suitability (0–1)",
      y = "Count",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )

  if (drop_x_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  }

  if (legend_inside) {
    p <- p + theme(
      legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),
      legend.justification = c(1, 1),
      legend.background = element_rect(
        fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.8),
        colour = NA
      ),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines")
    )
  }

  p
}

# ---- Build the two correct coarse/1° panels ----

p_ap <- p_ap + theme(aspect.ratio = 0.55)
p_co <- p_co + theme(aspect.ratio = 0.55)

p_ap <- make_coarse_hist(
  rast = apicalis_spatrast_coarse,
  m_sf = middens_sf,
  thr_a = thr_a,
  x_max = x_max,
  drop_x_axis = TRUE,
  legend_inside = FALSE
) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = Inf, label = "(a)",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2, fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

p_co <- make_coarse_hist(
  rast = conditor_spatrast_coarse,
  m_sf = middens_sf,
  thr_a = thr_a,
  x_max = x_max,
  drop_x_axis = FALSE,
  legend_inside = TRUE
) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = Inf, label = "(b)",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2, fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

# ---- Stack vertically (tight) ----
fig_ab <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p_ap,
  p_co,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 1),
  align = "v",
  axis = "lr"
)

print(fig_ab)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(combined_outdir, "figure_1_suitability_histograms.png"),
  fig_ab,
  width = 5,
  height = 7,
  dpi = dpi_out,
  bg = "white"
)
```

#model performance
```{r}
# ---- helper: make performance plot for a species ----
make_perf_plot <- function(models_tbl, species_expr) {

  workflow_labels <- c(
    default_gam = "Generalised Additive Model",
    default_gbm = "Boosted Tree",
    default_glm = "Generalised Linear Model",
    default_rf  = "Random Forest"
  )
  model_order <- c("Generalised Additive Model", "Boosted Tree", "Generalised Linear Model", "Random Forest")

  metric_labels <- c(boyce_cont = "Boyce Index", roc_auc = "AUC", tss_max = "TSS")

  color_map <- c(
    "Generalised Additive Model" = "#FF61C3",
    "Boosted Tree"               = "#00B140",
    "Generalised Linear Model"   = "#00BFFF",
    "Random Forest"              = "#BC43FF"
  )

  perf_data <- models_tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(metrics = purrr::map(result, collect_metrics, summarize = FALSE)) |>
    dplyr::select(wflow_id, metrics) |>
    tidyr::unnest(metrics) |>
    dplyr::filter(.metric %in% names(metric_labels)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model        = factor(workflow_labels[wflow_id], levels = model_order),
      metric_label = factor(metric_labels[.metric], levels = c("Boyce Index", "AUC", "TSS"))
    )

  ggplot2::ggplot(perf_data, ggplot2::aes(x = model, y = .estimate, fill = model)) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.9, outlier.shape = NA) +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(
      ggplot2::aes(colour = model),
      size = 1.3, width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, stroke = 0.3, shape = 21
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, name = "Model Type") +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = rep("black", length(model_order)), guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ metric_label, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = species_expr,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Performance metric"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.background  = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#EEEEEE", colour = NA),
      plot.background   = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.major  = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "white"),
      panel.grid.minor  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x      = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position   = "right", # will be overridden in combined
      legend.direction  = "vertical",
      legend.title      = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text       = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title        = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      strip.text        = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 5))
    )
}

# ---- build the two plots ----
p_apicalis  <- make_perf_plot(apicalis_models,  expression(italic("Leporillus apicalis")))
p_conditor  <- make_perf_plot(conditor_models,  expression(italic("Leporillus conditor")))

# ---- combine vertically, collect legend once, bottom-right ----
combined_perf <- (p_apicalis / p_conditor) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "right",
    legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.key = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )


# ---- save ----
ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(combined_outdir, "combined_ensemble_performance.jpg"),
  plot = combined_perf,
  width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

combined_perf
```

```{r}
# ---- combined ensemble performance (apicalis + conditor), matched y by metric ----
# Requires: apicalis_models, conditor_models already exist (from tune/workflowsets)
# Saves to: combined_outdir

# Paths (you already have this; keep if not defined earlier)
combined_outdir <- "C:/github/SNR_SDM/Results/stratified environmental sampling/combined plots"
dir.create(combined_outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Labels + aesthetics (shared across species)
workflow_labels <- c(
  default_gam = "Generalised Additive Model",
  default_gbm = "Boosted Tree",
  default_glm = "Generalised Linear Model",
  default_rf  = "Random Forest"
)
model_order <- c("Generalised Additive Model", "Boosted Tree", "Generalised Linear Model", "Random Forest")

metric_labels <- c(boyce_cont = "Boyce Index", roc_auc = "AUC", tss_max = "TSS")

color_map <- c(
  "Generalised Additive Model" = "#FF61C3",
  "Boosted Tree"               = "#00B140",
  "Generalised Linear Model"   = "#00BFFF",
  "Random Forest"              = "#BC43FF"
)

# ---- helper: extract fold-level metrics into a tidy table ----
make_perf_data <- function(models_tbl, species_name) {
  models_tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(metrics = purrr::map(result, collect_metrics, summarize = FALSE)) |>
    dplyr::select(wflow_id, metrics) |>
    tidyr::unnest(metrics) |>
    dplyr::filter(.metric %in% names(metric_labels)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      species      = factor(species_name, levels = c("Leporillus apicalis", "Leporillus conditor")),
      model        = factor(workflow_labels[wflow_id], levels = model_order),
      metric_label = factor(metric_labels[.metric], levels = c("Boyce Index", "AUC", "TSS"))
    )
}

perf_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  make_perf_data(apicalis_models, "Leporillus apicalis"),
  make_perf_data(conditor_models, "Leporillus conditor")
)

# ---- helper: y-limits per metric across BOTH species (adds small padding) ----
ylims_for_metric <- function(df) {
  range(df$.estimate, na.rm = TRUE)
}


# ---- helper: plot one metric column, with species stacked and shared y ----
make_metric_plot <- function(metric_name) {

  df_m  <- dplyr::filter(perf_all, metric_label == metric_name)
  ylims <- ylims_for_metric(df_m)

  # Force AUC axis limits (crops anything outside 0.8–1.0 visually)
  if (metric_name == "AUC") {
    ylims <- c(0.8, 1.0)
  }

  ggplot2::ggplot(df_m, ggplot2::aes(x = model, y = .estimate, fill = model)) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.9, outlier.shape = NA) +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(
      ggplot2::aes(colour = model),
      size = 1.3, width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, stroke = 0.3, shape = 21
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, name = "Model Type") +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = rep("black", length(model_order)), guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = ylims) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = ggplot2::vars(species)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = metric_name,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Performance metric"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.background  = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#EEEEEE", colour = NA),
      plot.background   = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.major  = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "white"),
      panel.grid.minor  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x      = ggplot2::element_blank(),

      # species headings above each row
      strip.placement   = "outside",
      strip.text.y      = ggplot2::element_text(face = "italic", size = 13),
      strip.background  = ggplot2::element_blank(),

      plot.title        = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.position   = "right"
    )
}


# Build the three metric columns
p_boyce <- make_metric_plot("Boyce Index")
p_auc   <- make_metric_plot("AUC")
p_tss   <- make_metric_plot("TSS")

# Combine into a 2x3 layout with ONE legend
combined_perf <- (p_boyce + p_auc + p_tss) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") &
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "right"
  )

# Save + print
ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(combined_outdir, "combined_ensemble_performance_matched_y.jpg"),
  plot = combined_perf,
  width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

combined_perf
```
